metadata.title: Integrated laboratory evolution and rational engineering of GalP/Glk-dependent Escherichia coli for higher yield and productivity of L-tryptophan biosynthesis

reference.title: Integrated laboratory evolution and rational engineering of GalP/Glk-dependent Escherichia coli for higher yield and productivity of L-tryptophan biosynthesis

target.condition: M9 + glucose sole carbon source, initial OD600 0.10, ~60 h

trigger.observation: 化学计量分析：PTS每内化1 mol葡萄糖消耗1 mol PEP，PTS菌株Trp理论得率上限0.227 g/g，GalP/Glk路线可达0.454 g/g
trigger.reasoning: Construct PTS-defective Trp producer to redirect PEP from glucose transport into Trp biosynthesis

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | 基于化学计量/理论得率计算（Fig. S1），属硬证据

alternatives.approach: Zymomonas mobilis Glf + Glk 路线（文献提及，未采用）

decision_chain.implementation_detail: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of ptsI → strain G028

result.after: G028 reached OD600 0.21 +/- 0.02 after ~60 h — glucose uptake blocked, growth severely impaired (direct_observation)

decision_chain.rule: 在以PEP为限速前体的芳香族产物宿主中，失活PTS并启用非PTS葡萄糖摄取（如GalP/Glk）可理论性提高产品得率，但需同时解决生长受损问题

target.condition: M9 agar → 96-deep-well M9 screen → FM-III batch fermentation in 50 mL conical tubes, 37 C 250 rpm

trigger.observation: ptsI敲除导致葡萄糖摄取阻断、生长严重受损（exp1实测OD600仅0.21）
trigger.reasoning: Restore glucose uptake/growth of PTS-defective strain by modulating galP/glk expression

evidence.source_location: S028 positive control (H1-H6); G028GG non-mutated synthetic promoter reference (H7-H12)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | 筛选结果来自实测生长与荧光数据
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Random mutagenesis of galP/glk promoter -10/-35 elements (plasmid library pCmN20-GG^MT), CRISPR/Cas9 chromosomal integration → G028a mutants

result.after: 12 mutants with growth >1.25 and high MFU; best 4 still below S028 — further evolution needed (direct_observation)

decision_chain.rule: PTS缺陷菌株中可通过启动子文库调节替代性葡萄糖摄取/磷酸化途径（GalP/Glk）的表达强度，在生长恢复与产物合成间取得平衡

target.condition: batch ALE (details supplement-dependent); fed-batch evaluation DASGIP, initial glucose 25 g/L, OD600 0.45

trigger.observation: 启动子工程突变体的生长和MFU仍低于阳性对照S028

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | 进化产物经实测发酵表征
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Batch-mode adaptive laboratory evolution (details in Supplementary Materials)

result.metric: growth, Trp, yield, qTrp, glucose uptake rate, shikimate, pyruvate
result.after: K3: yield 0.137 g/g (below S028 0.150), higher glucose uptake in stationary phase (4.10 g/L/h, 40-50 h), pyruvate 2.95 g/L (~5x S028), lower shikimate; no mutations in galP/glk/galR (direct_observation); authors hypothesize evolution favored pyruvate-synthesis for growth over Trp (author_interpretation)

target.condition: SynM + 15 ug/mL Cm + 25 ug/mL Kan, 30 C, OD600 setpoint 0.8, inlet 60-80 mL/h, constant 30 mL; phase 1: 0-380 h; phase 2: 381-550 h

trigger.observation: 分批ALE得到的K3得率未提高，且进化方向偏向生长（丙酮酸合成）而非Trp生产；需要更高效的进化方法
trigger.reasoning: Obtain a better GalP/Glk-dependent Trp producer with higher yield via automated continuous evolution
trigger.source_location: G028JC (G028Cm/pJC184/pCas9MT) with integrated promoter library; phase 2 seeded with best phase-1 mutant G028c

evidence.source_location: S028, K3, G028c positive controls in 96-well characterization

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | 系统输出为实时实测OD与荧光；产物经发酵实测验证

alternatives.approach: 分批ALE（已实施，效果不足，故开发连续系统）

decision_chain.implementation_detail: Continuous ALE in auxostat with arabinose-induced in vivo mutagenesis (pJC184 mutators), real-time OD600 feedback control of flow rates and online flow-cytometry fluorescence monitoring (auto-CGSS)

result.metric: real-time OD600 + MFU; offline: 10 h SynM 96-well growth/MFU, 20 h FM-III shake-flask growth/MFU
result.after: Phase-1 fluorescence max ~11,446 MFU at 126 h then declined to 8,000-9,000; phase-2 max ~13,541 MFU (~390-438 h) with late decline; later time-point colonies grew better but had lower MFU (6480.30 +/- 872.70 vs 10230.70 +/- 1136.60) — PTS-defective cells preferentially evolve toward growth over Trp synthesis; 10 mutants with MFU >10000 advanced; T5 selected as best (direct_observation)

target.condition: DASGIP 4x1.5 L, initial working volume 500 mL, 65 h, initial glucose 25 g/L, inoculation OD600 0.45

trigger.observation: Phase-1 fluorescence max ~11,446 MFU at 126 h then declined to 8,000-9,000; phase-2 max ~13,541 MFU (~390-438 h) with late decline; later time-point colonies grew better but had lower MFU (6480.30 +/- 872.70 vs 10230.70 +/- 1136.60) — PTS-defective cells preferentially evolve toward growth over Trp synthesis; 10 mutants with MFU >10000 advanced; T5 selected as best (direct_observation)
trigger.reasoning: Evaluate T5 production performance in fed-batch (phenotype validation of evolved strain)
trigger.source_location: T5 (pJC184 cured via Cas9/sgRNA-CmR cleavage induced by IPTG)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 自动判定失败——请人工判定
decision_chain.implementation_detail: none beyond plasmid curing; fed-batch fermentation

result.metric: OD600, DCW, Trp, qTrp, yield, Vp, SA, DSA
result.after: T5: 38.77 +/- 0.02 g/L Trp, yield 0.164 g/g, qTrp 25.28 mg/gDCW/h, DCW 22.89 +/- 0.20 g/L (32.02% below S028); yield still far below theoretical maxima; SA/DSA accumulation patterns similar to S028 indicating downstream pathway limitation (direct_observation)

trigger.observation: T5得率仍远低于理论最大值，且SA/DSA积累提示下游通路受限；此前研究已证明两变体可显著提高Trp产量和葡萄糖转化得率
trigger.reasoning: Further enhance Trp synthesis by integrating previously validated enzyme variants into evolved and reference backgrounds

evidence.source_location: internal comparison T5AA vs S028AA; contextual comparison to T5/S028

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | 变体效果在此前的实测研究中已验证（Chen et al. 2018, 2019），本研究再次经发酵实测
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Chromosomal integration of aroG(D6G-D7A) (L-phenylalanine-resistant DAHP synthase) and AntrpC(R378F) (anthranilate-activated enzyme) → T5AA and S028AA (Figs. S6-S7; details in Supplementary Materials)

result.metric: growth, Trp, glucose, yield, qTrp, Vp
result.after: T5AA: yield 0.195 g/g (+18.90% vs T5; +5.41% vs S028AA), 41.49 +/- 0.03 g/L Trp (+7.03% vs T5), qTrp 28.83 mg/gDCW/h, DCW 23.17 g/L (28.20% below S028AA); S028AA: 0.185 g/g, 48.27 g/L, Vp 0.77 vs 0.67 g/L/h — T5AA lower volumetric productivity due to growth defect (direct_observation); authors attribute improved yield mainly to increased PEP availability (author_interpretation)

decision_chain.rule: 在芳香族氨基酸生产中，将抗反馈抑制的DAHP合酶与利用途径中间体前馈激活的下游酶变体组合，可协同提高碳流向目标产物的分配

trigger.observation: T5AA: yield 0.195 g/g (+18.90% vs T5; +5.41% vs S028AA), 41.49 +/- 0.03 g/L Trp (+7.03% vs T5), qTrp 28.83 mg/gDCW/h, DCW 23.17 g/L (28.20% below S028AA); S028AA: 0.185 g/g, 48.27 g/L, Vp 0.77 vs 0.67 g/L/h — T5AA lower volumetric productivity due to growth defect (direct_observation); authors attribute improved yield mainly to increased PEP availability (author_interpretation)

evidence.source_location: reference genome E. coli W3110; key mutations cross-checked in S028 by PCR sequencing

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 自动判定失败——请人工判定

result.after: mlc(dgsA) deletion, zwf E165Stop, galP K137T/P195A/F204L among 20 affected loci (direct_observation); functional consequences are author_interpretation requiring confirmation

trigger.reasoning: Explore structural effect of GalP mutations (K137T, P195A, F204L) on glucose permeation

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 自动启发式判定(软): 基于证据关键词匹配——需人工确认

result.after: Mutations hypothesized to increase ICH flexibility and glucose-binding affinity (author_interpretation; authors state confirmation by further experiments is needed)

engineering_problem.problem_statement: Develop a GalP/Glk-dependent PTS-deficient E. coli L-tryptophan producer to exploit the ~2x higher theoretical Trp yield of PTS-independent glucose uptake, by combining CRISPR/Cas9-facilitated promoter engineering of galP/glk, batch-mode ALE, and a novel continuous automatic evolution system (auto-CGSS) coupling in vivo mutagenesis with real-time growth and Trp-biosensor fluorescence monitoring; then integrate previously engineered enzyme variants AroG(D6G-D7A) and AnTrpC(R378F) to further raise yield and specific production rate.
